acquisition: Seeded two-route geometries and independent per-action baseline samples from stationary move probabilities .75/.8/.9, with 32..64 samples per action. Captured aggregate counts are unordered; no history is reconstructed.
analysis: Retain every case, stage and seed. Equal-weight seed means and paired seed differences are descriptive; stages/cases within a seed are correlated, not independent replicates. No significance test, tuning, dominance gate or promotion.
metrics: Record per-event pre-update binary Brier and natural log loss, absolute probability error against held-out truth, local selections, switches and evidence. First recent-selection delay counts target visits and stream events, not calibrated detection delay. Stage selection summaries use stage-relative visits and event offsets; first_recent_event is the global stream index, first_recent_event_relative subtracts the stage offset, and recent_at_entry distinguishes already-active recency. Whole-case summaries span that case lifetime. Stationary recent selections/switches are descriptive false-switch proxies with no statistical error-rate guarantee. Independent synchronous contraction iteration evaluates empirical residual/MAE and current-dynamics frozen-policy discounted start-value regret; evaluation never updates a model.
rule: Score Beta(.5,.5) binary move predictions before updates; local evidence = .95 * evidence + log(p_recent(outcome)/p_cumulative(outcome)). Select recent iff fresh_count >= 4 and evidence > log(4), otherwise cumulative. Guarded recent forecasts cumulative until four previous fresh events, then recent. Planning uses unsmoothed positive integer counts; no edges are fabricated.
scope: Exploratory finite synthetic supplied-outcome streams, not autonomous exploration, neural learning, biological equivalence or checkpoint promotion. Parameters are fixed before the eight-seed pilot and are not tuned on its outcomes. Truth is withheld from memory and planners. Smoothed forecasts and integer-count planning are distinct. A discounted predictive score is a heuristic, not a posterior or calibrated detector. Equal backup caps do not imply equal computation. SHA256 checks consistency, not authenticity.

streams.ambiguity: Identical baselines and W collisions per target are presented to two memories with different evaluation-only truths. Their forecasts, selected graphs and diagnostic state must be identical.
streams.conditional_adverse: W forced collisions per target under unchanged truth, followed by 48 unconditional recovery samples. Conditional stress, not its frequency.
streams.gradual: 96 outcomes alternating targets; each pair probability decreases linearly to .1 over 48 events then returns over 48; checkpoints every 24.
streams.reversals: Four 32-outcome blocks: closure, reopening, closure, reopening. Each truth change has a zero-observation/zero-backup checkpoint before sampling.
streams.sparse: Close the first target without observations; sample the second target 24 times, revisit closed target twice, sample second 24 more times, revisit closed target 16 times. A third baseline action is never observed.
streams.stationary: 96 unconditional independent outcomes, alternating target actions; checkpoints every 32.
